Definition: properly, drawn off, i.e. separated; hence, a small company (as divided from the rest)
BiblicalUsage: The word means a small flock, a little company drawn off from the rest, and Israel looks like two little flocks of kids pitched against the Syrians who fill the country. The picture is deliberate: tiny Israel against a host.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God delights to give the victory to the little flock, so that no one mistakes whose battle it was.
RelatedPeople: King Ahab; Ben-Hadad II, King of Syria
